citations.sql_query: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS year, (oi.promo_id IS NOT NULL OR oi.promo_id_2 IS NOT NULL) AS used_promotion, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_orders, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS net_sales, SUM(oi.discount_amount) AS total_discount FROM commerce.orders AS o INNER JOIN commerce.order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2022-12-31' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date), (oi.promo_id IS NOT NULL OR oi.promo_id_2 IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 100
